title: Selective Hydration Priority Queue Simulator
problemStatement: Implement `createHydrationScheduler(chunks)` that hydrates chunks in background order unless a user click event occurs on a specific chunk, which immediately elevates that chunk to the front of the hydration queue.
interviewTrap: In traditional SSR, the user must wait for the entire page to hydrate before any button responds. React 18 Selective Hydration intercepts clicks on un-hydrated islands and hydrates them synchronously before dispatching the event.

testCases.name: Correctly records and tracks hydrated chunks

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: React Server Components execute strictly on the server and stream a JSON-like Flight wire format (not HTML, not JS bundle). Client components are represented as module references ($L/esm) that hydrate selectively.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Render Phase: Fiber node evaluation and hooks linked-list dispatch for Event-Driven Hydration Prioritization (React 18 Selective Hydration).
2. Reconciliation: Double buffering and fiber diffing mechanics.
3. Commit Phase: Synchronous/passive effect execution and DOM mutation.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals: In React Fiber, Event-Driven Hydration Prioritization (React 18 Selective Hydration) maintains state across work-in-progress trees and lanes scheduling priority.

complexity.time: O(1) per hook / O(N) fiber traversal
